title: FitPlate ValidationReport
description: Machine-generated result of measuring an actual STEP artefact against a frozen TaskSpec + scene. The validator re-imports the STEP file and re-measures; it never trusts values echoed back from the generator or from the DesignSpec. 'overall' may be PASS only when all of G01..G08 are present, every one is PASS and there are no errors -- a missing check, an UNKNOWN or a BORDERLINE result can never be reported as an accepted part. Cross-field rules (duplicate check ids, PASS consistency, measured/required/reason requirements) live in geometry/fitplate/schema.py.

preview_mesh_sha256.description: Raw-byte hash of the preview_mesh.json that shipped with this candidate, when one was present at validation time.

validator_code_sha256.description: Canonical hash of the validator modules that decided this report: per-module SHA-256 of fitplate/constraints.py, fitplate/inspect_step.py and fitplate/scene.py, mapped over a sorted compact JSON object and hashed again. Optional for historical report samples, but a production report must carry it and an export must refuse a report whose value is missing or does not match the installed code.

hashes.description: step_sha256 is the raw-byte hash of the exported STEP file; task_sha256/scene_sha256 are canonical content hashes of the frozen inputs; validator_code_sha256 binds the report to the code that produced it. A report whose hashes do not match the current inputs or code is stale and cannot be used as evidence.

id.description: G01 solid validity, G02 plate size/pose, G03 base holes, G04 sensor hole group, G05 hole ligaments, G06 assembly free space, G07 frozen-condition preservation, G08 export consistency.

status.description: BORDERLINE means the measurement landed inside the numeric uncertainty band: require more margin or human review -- never widen epsilon to turn it into PASS.

objects.description: The scene object ids / reserved participants involved in this result (empty array for whole-artefact checks).

minimum_pair_distance_mm.description: G06 assembly free space (added 2026-10-08): the minimum distance over ALL measured pairs, allowed support contacts included - it may legitimately read 0 when the device rests on the plate. The legacy minimum_clearance_mm carries the same value under its old name; new readers use this field.

minimum_free_clearance_mm.description: G06 (added 2026-10-08): the minimum distance EXCLUDING allowed support contacts; null when no free pair was measured (never 0 as a stand-in for 'no free pair'). Absent in reports predating the free-clearance summary, where consumers may derive it from evidence.pairs instead.

minimum_free_clearance_pair.description: G06 (added 2026-10-08): the moving/fixed ids of the free-clearance pair. Ties are broken on (moving, fixed) at the 6-decimal precision the pairs carry, so the choice is reproducible from evidence.pairs. null when there is no free pair.

support_contact_status.description: G06 (added 2026-10-08): aggregate of the ALLOWED support pairs only. SEATED = every support contact is actually seated (|gap| within epsilon); GAP_BORDERLINE = no penetration/missing contact but a support gap inside the uncertainty band; NOT_SEATED = at least one declared support contact is missing (the device floats); PENETRATION = a support pair intersects (still a FAIL pair); NONE = no support pair was measured; POSE_UNKNOWN = no pose was derived (G04 not passed), so nothing was measured and no numbers are reported.

measured.description: Actual re-measured values. Must be non-empty for PASS and FAIL; a null value means 'not measured'.

required.description: The requirement this check compared against.

reason_code.description: Required whenever status is not PASS.

previewArtifact.$comment: Contract for candidates/<candidate_id>/preview.json, emitted by the viewer work (T09); defined here so the identity binding is fixed before any viewer exists. Every preview mesh must carry the STEP hash and the candidate identity of the exact artefact it visualises, so a viewer can never render a mesh that does not correspond to the validated entity. The front end must not re-draw a 'looks the same' plate from the DesignSpec.
